title_sq: Apartament ne shitje te rezidenca Ballada!
description_sq:
Shitet garsoniere, 39.5 m2, kati 2, orientim perendim te rezidenca Ballada.
Pagese 20% realizohet me lidhjen e kontrates dhe 80% ne momentin qe apartamenti eshte i perfunduar totalisht me dyer, dritare, grila, laminat AC5 dhe tualet i kompletuar me hidrosanitare inkaso.
Mundesi kreditimi 80% me kolateralin e kompanise. Rezidenca Ballada eshte e pozicionuar prane liqenit te Farkes dhe Unazes se Madhe dhe ofron nje jetese te qete prane natyres por me akses te menjehershem me Tiranen. Rezidenca Ballada ka hapesira te dedikuara per kembesore te vecuara nga rruget e makinave.
title_en: Apartment for sale in Ballada residence!
description_en: Studio for sale, 39.5 m2, 2nd floor, west orientation, Ballada residence. 20% payment is made with the conclusion of the contract and 80% when the apartment is completely finished with doors, windows, shutters, AC5 laminate and a toilet complete with incaso plumbing. Possibility of 80% credit with the company's collateral. The Ballada Residence is located near Farka Lake and the Great Ring Road and offers a quiet lifestyle close to nature but with immediate access to Tirana. The Ballada residence has spaces dedicated to pedestrians separated from the car roads.
